theme: An open day, with Croatia logistics to close out.
greeting: The calendar is empty today, Dan — no meetings to make. The one live thread is the Croatia trip: a couple of booking windows close today, with the girls home in St. Pete.

needsAttention.title: St. Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20-22 is still open: you land TPA Sunday the 20th but the girls aren't picked up until Tuesday the 22nd, so two St. Pete nights need booking. The Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb is only pending confirmation, so it's worth a glance to see it converted.

needsAttention.title: Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy ticket shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site using the record locator and buy bags now if they aren't included — European counter fees run well above the online price.

needsAttention.title: Last Dubrovnik night, Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Aug 23 on the Mike + Dan board: one room in Cavtat near the airport for the night after disembarking, ahead of the 7:30am Sunday flight from DBV.

flagged.title: SVP, Global Public Policy application
flagged.detail: A SourceHire note asks you to confirm work authorization to keep the application moving; the employer shows only as Confidential, so worth verifying the sender before sharing anything.

flagged.title: Kuala Lumpur invite from CGI
flagged.detail: K. Waring at CGI writes that speaker slots are filled but it would be good for you to meet the corporate audience; they depart for Tokyo Sep 26 and are waiting to hear if you're interested.

inbox.noise: The rest is airline check-in reminders, an Airbnb thank-you the host already hearted, and a MaineHealth survey.

recipe.title: Salmon Baked in Foil
recipe.why: A light foil-wrapped supper that lets high-summer herbs and lemon carry the plate.

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar — an open stretch, with the girls home in St. Pete.
The Croatia trip is the live thread: two booking windows close today and one is already overdue.
Nothing scheduled — a quiet close at the Kenwood place.
